odteste.comando.erro.elemento: Unknown element: %s. Use nenhum, sangue, conhecimento, morte or energia.
odteste.comando.erro.estagio: Missing the Mark stage for %s (1 to 4). Only "nenhum" can skip the stage.
odteste.momento.marca.morte: Time slowed down on your skin.
odteste.horror.exposicao.comum.1: Nothing has looked at you. Yet.
odteste.horror.exposicao.comum.3: You are still just one of many.
odteste.horror.exposicao.baixa.1: You heard something. It heard you.
odteste.horror.exposicao.media.1: There are footsteps that match yours.
odteste.horror.exposicao.alta.1: Someone stands at the edge of your sight. They are still there.
odteste.horror.exposicao.alta.3: What looks back already knows your name.
odteste.horror.exposicao.critica.1: You are no longer the one searching.
odteste.horror.exposicao.critica.2: The door is open. On the other side, they are waiting.
odteste.horror.lucidez.firme.1: Feet on the ground. For now.
odteste.horror.lucidez.firme.2: What you see is what exists.
odteste.horror.lucidez.firme.3: Breathe. Everything is in its place.
odteste.horror.lucidez.alta.1: Something is out of place. You haven't found it yet.
odteste.horror.lucidez.media.1: You no longer trust what you hear.
odteste.horror.lucidez.media.2: The door you closed is open.
odteste.horror.lucidez.baixa.1: Your own voice whispers from across the room.
odteste.horror.lucidez.baixa.2: You no longer know who is calling you.
odteste.horror.lucidez.baixa.3: What is real drifts away from you.
odteste.horror.lucidez.surto.2: There is no floor. Only what you think is there.
odteste.horror.lucidez.surto.3: You are lost and cannot find the way.
odteste.configuration.title: Od Teste
odteste.configuration.efeitos_fortes.too: Camera shake, tilt and visual hallucinations (figures, doors, blocks). SUAVE halves it; DESLIGADO leaves only vignette, sound and text.
odteste.ato1.abertura: %s. You heard the bell and came in. It was before. You only forgot.
odteste.ato1.troca.1: It is not hunger. It is a call.
odteste.ato1.troca.2: The bell has not finished counting.
odteste.ato1.troca.3: He slept there. Now he does not sleep.
odteste.ato1.livro_carniceiro.1.pagina1:
Five steps at a time.

Whoever counts in a hurry loses the way. The bell teaches you to listen. The rest, the flesh teaches.
odteste.ato1.livro_carniceiro.1.pagina2: (On the back, a circle scratched in charcoal. They never finished drawing it.)
odteste.ato1.mapa_esquerda.descricao: A cartographer's map, cut in half.
odteste.ato1.admin.enigma_sino: %s solved the Village Bell. The chest opened.
odteste.evento.primeiro_sinal.ok: First Sign released for %s. Bell at %s %s %s. Banner: %s. Villager vanished: %s.
odteste.evento.desfazer.ok: Undone for %s. Blocks a player had already changed (left as they are): %s. Villager came back: %s.
odteste.evento.erro.sem_grupo: There is no group %s. Create it with /odteste grupo criar.
odteste.evento.erro.ja_marcada: Group %s already has a marked village. Use /odteste evento desfazer %1$s first.
odteste.evento.erro.dimensao: The saved dimension no longer exists.
odteste.evento.erro.ninguem_online: Nobody from group %s is online. Give a point: /odteste evento primeiro_sinal %1$s <x y z>.
odteste.evento.erro.sem_vila: No free village bell near %s %s %s (loaded chunks without claims only).
odteste.evento.erro.sem_espaco: No free space near the bell at %s %s %s for the note block, chest and sign. Nothing was touched.
odteste.evento.erro.nada_para_desfazer: Group %s has no event to undo.
odteste.evento.erro.descarregado: Chunk not loaded at %s %s %s. Go there and try again (undo never loads chunks).
odteste.grupo.erro.nome: Invalid name: %s (lowercase letters, numbers and _, up to 24).
odteste.grupo.erro.tem_evento: Group %s has an active event. Undo it before deleting.
odteste.estrutura.prever.cabe: %s fits here (%s blocks). You can now use colocar with the same point.
odteste.estrutura.prever.nao_cabe: %s does not fit here: blocked at %s %s %s (%s). colocar will look for another point nearby.
odteste.estrutura.erro.prever_antes: Run /odteste estrutura prever with the same template, point and rotation first (valid for 5 minutes).
odteste.estrutura.erro.sem_lugar: %s did not fit, not even nearby. Last block at %s %s %s (%s). Nothing was placed.
odteste.estrutura.colocada_outro_lugar: %s did not fit at the point: placed at %s %s %s. Id: %s (to undo).
odteste.estrutura.desfeita: Placement %s undone. Blocks a player had already changed (left as they are): %s.
